country.name: Equatorial Guinea
country.jurisdictionNotice: Education authority spans early childhood, primary, secondary, technical-professional and university subsectors, while provincial and district records remain necessary for school-level status. Foreign-system schools require separate authorization and curriculum treatment.
country.languagePolicy: Spanish, French and Portuguese are official languages with different practical education coverage. Fang, Bubi, Ndowe, Bisio, Annobonese and other national-language contexts require exact community, variety, orthography, locality and curriculum review; translation is not localization.

review.policy: No category becomes verified without a named qualified Equatoguinean reviewer and current evidence from the competent ministry, provincial or district authority, BOE, INEGE or institution.

governanceModel.summary: The ministry responsible for Education, Science, Professional Education and Sports governs national education subsectors through its competent directorates; higher-education institution and program status requires exact legal and ministry evidence.
governanceModel.schoolRule: Preserve official institution name and identifier, island or mainland region, province, district, locality, level, sector, authorization, curriculum system, current operating status and source date. Statistical enumeration is not live authorization.
governanceModel.higherEducationRule: Legal creation, current operation, campus, exact program, award authority, homologation and recognition are separate claims.

authorities.name: Ministry responsible for Education, Science, Professional Education and Sports
authorities.role: national education policy and administration across assigned subsectors

authorities.name: Directorate-General for Early Childhood, Preschool, Primary, Special Education and Literacy
authorities.role: assigned early and primary education oversight

authorities.name: Directorate-General for Regulated Vocational Training
authorities.role: technical-professional education and provider oversight within its mandate

authorities.name: Directorate-General for University Education and Research
authorities.role: higher-education oversight and qualification homologation within its mandate

authorities.name: Provincial and district education services
authorities.role: territorial school administration and current institution-record validation

authorities.name: Governing Body for Personal Data Protection and General Data Protection Registry
authorities.role: personal-data governance and registry under Law No. 1/2016

authorities.name: Ministry responsible for Social Affairs and Gender Equality

curriculum.title: Official programs by level, grade, subject, technical stream and language
curriculum.implementationRule: The General Education Law establishes the system but is not the complete controlling curriculum for every grade and subject. A government announcement, textbook, examination guide or foreign cooperation resource is not the controlling national curriculum. Verify level, grade, subject or stream, language, approving instrument, version and effective year.
curriculum.supplementPolicy: Education law, curriculum framework, subject program, textbook, examination guide, foreign-system curriculum and external resource are separate layers.

schoolDirectory.authority: Education ministry and responsible provincial or district service
schoolDirectory.scopeNotice: No verified unified current public directory of all authorized and operating public, private, technical, foreign-system and special schools was located. INEGE statistical tables and government announcements are not authorization records. Verify each institution with the competent territorial and subsector authority.
requiredRecordFields: island or mainland region, province, district and locality
level, services, language and curriculum system
public, private, confessional, foreign-system or other sector
observation date, source and review date

educationStatistics.scopeNotice: The 2026 Statistical Yearbook reports official multi-source data updated through December 2025, while earlier education tables may refer to older school years such as 2020/2021. Preserve observation or school year, source department, level, region, province or district, sector, definition and denominator. Statistics are not school authorization.

vocationalQualifications.authorityNotice: A proposed qualifications catalogue or professional-training law is not a completed register. Provider authorization, exact program, occupational standard, assessment, qualification, award authority, level and validity must be verified separately.

higherEducation.authority: Competent university-education directorate and legal authority
higherEducation.authorityNotice: Institution creation or public-university status does not authorize every campus, program, modality or award. Verify the legal instrument, current operation, exact program, curriculum, degree authority, campus, homologation, recognition and validity separately. A university’s own website is evidence about its claims, not independent regulatory confirmation.

privacyAndSafeguarding.dataProtectionLaw: Law No. 1/2016 of 22 July on Personal Data Protection
privacyAndSafeguarding.dataProtectionAuthority: Governing Body for Personal Data Protection and General Data Protection Registry; current operational identity and public contact require verification
privacyAndSafeguarding.childrenFramework: General Education Law, applicable criminal and family law, Law No. 2/2021 on Adoption of Minors and the November 2023 decree on protection of minors
privacyAndSafeguarding.scopeNotice: Verify registration, lawful basis, sensitive data, learner and guardian rights, transfers, retention, security and incidents under Law No. 1/2016 with the competent operational body. The 2023 decree imposes specific school safeguarding duties, but current education-sector reporting, referral, identity-control, consent, inclusion and emergency procedures still require review before a real learner pilot.

culturalAndLanguageRequirements.rule: Spanish, French, Portuguese and national languages have distinct official, instructional, foreign-language and community roles. Fang, Bubi, Ndowe, Bisio, Annobonese and other language varieties require exact orthography, locality, curriculum approval and community review. Automatic translation is not localization.

completionCriteria: A qualified Equatoguinean education reviewer is named.
Current ministry, subsector, provincial, district, university and data-protection responsibilities are verified.
A verified current comprehensive school authorization directory is documented or the gap remains visible.
Every statistic preserves observation year, source department, level, geography, sector, definition and denominator.
Every curriculum record preserves level, grade, subject or stream, language, instrument, version and effective year.
Every higher-education claim separately verifies legal creation, current operation, campus, exact program, award, homologation, recognition and validity.
Law No. 1/2016 operations and current child-safeguarding procedures are approved before a real learner pilot.
Spanish, French, Portuguese and national-language resources preserve their distinct contexts.
